verdict.rationale: Penpot documents an open plugin API and a plugin system for building and publishing custom extensions, plus API access via access tokens and outbound webhooks. Together these give developers and agents first-party programmatic surfaces to build against, but the evidence never describes a packaged official SDK, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: explicitly named official SDK packages or client libraries, language coverage, SDK reference docs or a published API spec, independent hands-on corroboration of building with them.
